summary: Do not initiate a goals-of-care or palliative-care conversation from this snapshot alone. The record instead supports prompt human clinical review of symptomatic persistent hyperglycaemia and the latest potassium/renal results. The available longitudinal material does not document progressive advanced illness, functional decline, repeated acute-care use, or active advance-care planning, but those domains are incompletely represented and therefore remain unknown.
